spec.claim_summary: Long BTCUSDT on 1H when price crosses above the 20 EMA and the next candle closes above the prior high, with 2x ATR(14) stop and 1.8R target.
assumptions: Timeframe is 1h as stated: 1H EMA / 1H chart.
Asset BTCUSDT maps Bybit BTC/USDT to Binance spot BTCUSDT; exchange feed difference is ignored.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: Bybit-specific price feed; tested on Binance proxy.
'moves above the 20 EMA' compiled as close crosses_above 20-period EMA rather than just close above EMA.
Two-bar sequence compiled with offsets so all conditions can hold on same entry bar: cross occurred on prior bar (offset 1) and confirmation close above prior high on entry bar.
Stop ATR length 14 from ATR instruction; stop multiplier 2 and 1.8R target from SL/TP formulas.
No indicator exit stated; exit is via ATR stop and R-multiple target only.
Claimed period 2021-01-01 to 2023-03-15 uses explicit January 2021 backtest start and 2023-03-15 post date as end of 'last 2 years' window.

evidence.quote: on the 1H chart of BTC/USDT on Bybit
Every time the price moves above the 20 EMA on the 1H chart of BTC/USDT on Bybit
If the next candle closed above the previous candle's high
SL will be at the current price - (2 * ATR indicator)
TP will be at the current price + 1.8 * (current price - SL price )
